name: A build assuming PAGE == 4096 running on this host's page size
component: ground-truth pairing for jemalloc's pages.c:760 check
required_postconditions: sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE) <= 4096, so the shipping guard is not taken

failure_sink.description: the case reports `refused` when os_page > PAGE, which is where the real code aborts

extraction_limitations: Single-claim contract written to pair with a ground-truth case. It asserts exactly one thing so that a whole-contract verdict can be compared against a single observation without ambiguity.
x_groundtruth: cases/page_size_at_most.c implements `if (os_page > PAGE) abort()` longhand. The relation is at_most; testing equality here was defect 4 of the July campaign.
